fusions.name: Harpoon Report
fusions.desc: Fires a barbed harpoon at an enemy up to 9 tiles away that deals 30 piercing damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Barbshot Spray
fusions.desc: Fires a spray of barbs that deals 4 piercing damage to everything in a cone 5 tiles long. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Barrel
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Primed Chamber
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 35% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
